title: Temporary visitation.
bodyText:
(a) A court of this State which does not have jurisdiction to modify a child-custody determination, may issue a temporary order enforcing:

(1) A visitation schedule made by a court of another state; or

(2) The visitation provisions of a child-custody determination of another state that does not provide for a specific visitation schedule.

(b) If a court of this State makes an order under subsection (a)(2), it shall specify in the order a period that it considers adequate to allow the petitioner to obtain an order from a court having jurisdiction under the criteria specified in part II. The order remains in effect until an order is obtained from the other court or the period expires.
bodyHtml:
[§583A-304]  Temporary visitation.  (a)  A court of this State which does not have jurisdiction to modify a child-custody determination, may issue a temporary order enforcing:

     (1)  A visitation schedule made by a court of another state; or

     (2)  The visitation provisions of a child-custody determination of another state that does not provide for a specific visitation schedule.

     (b)  If a court of this State makes an order under subsection (a)(2), it shall specify in the order a period that it considers adequate to allow the petitioner to obtain an order from a court having jurisdiction under the criteria specified in part II.  The order remains in effect until an order is obtained from the other court or the period expires. [L 2002, c 124, pt of §2]
